## Automated Tests Required

### S11-DRAG-RUNTIME-RETEST-001 — Drag-and-Drop Runtime Retest — Integration (manual runtime evidence)

**Story file**: `production/epics/hand-ui/story-018-drag-runtime-retest.md`
**Test type**: Integration — manual runtime evidence (NOT a code-change story unless a follow-on repair story is authored; see `HU-DRAG-RT-05`).

**Automated tests**: no new automated tests added by this story. Existing automated tests (`hand_ui_drag_to_board_cell_test`, `hand_ui_drag_to_fan_plate_test`, the PROMPT 696 / 697 / 706 / 709 cohort) MUST remain green at the Sprint 11 retest commit. Verify by running:

```text
cargo test -p client --no-fail-fast
```

with no test in the drag / hand-ui surface regressing vs Sprint 10 close-out baseline (`origin/main@a6132d7`).

**What to verify in evidence**:

- Runtime trace captured under `RUST_LOG=client::ui::hand=trace,client::presentation::board_rendering=trace,client::card_animations::input_gating=info,lightyear=info,server::game=info` (per story §"Reproduction Recipe").
- Raw log capture preserved at `production/qa/evidence/sprint-11-drag-runtime-evidence.md` and per-attempt files under `production/qa/evidence/captures/sprint-11-drag-runtime/`.
- S1-S5 grey-square attribution truth-table locked (PASS / FAIL / NOT-OBSERVED per row, with evidence pointer).
- Disposition recorded as exactly one of `{bug-reproduced, bug-fixed, cannot-reproduce, third-party-limitation}`.
- If `bug-reproduced`: follow-on repair story authored at `production/epics/hand-ui/story-019-<slug>.md` with precise repro; **no repair commit lands inside `S11-DRAG-RUNTIME-RETEST-001`**.
- If `cannot-reproduce`: follow-on diagnostic-only story with tighter capture spec.
- No production code modified under `client/`, `server/`, `shared/`, `tests/` by this story (`HU-DRAG-RT-05`).
- No new client-side optimistic authority for stage / activate / submit (`HU-DRAG-RT-06`; ADR-002 + ADR-009).

**Edge cases** (per story §"Friend-game route"):

- Drag attempt A: standard unit onto BoardCell → expect S1 → S2 → S3 → S4 → S5 PASS chain.
- Drag attempt B: Instant card onto fan plate → expect S1 → S2 → S3 → S4 → S5 PASS chain (fan-plate branch).
- Drag attempt C: cancel mid-drag off any valid target → expect S1 → S2 → S3 → S4 (cursor-outside) → S5 (no-op cleanup); **no** `C2SActivateCard` send.
- Drag attempt D: invalid drop on opponent lane / out-of-spawn-range cell → expect S1 → S2 → S3 → S4 (invalid target) → S5 (snap-back); **no** `C2SActivateCard` send.

**Time-box**: 1.0 day per `S11-DRAG-RUNTIME-RETEST-001` AC. If S1-S5 cannot be filled in 1.0 day, lock truth-table as best-effort with `NOT-OBSERVED` rows explicitly named and disposition `cannot-reproduce`.

**Evidence path**: `production/qa/evidence/sprint-11-drag-runtime-evidence.md` (NEW).

## Manual Runtime Evidence Expectations

This section codifies the manual-evidence bar for the two Sprint 11 rows that require physical / observable verification beyond automated tests.

### Drag-and-Drop Runtime (`S11-DRAG-RUNTIME-RETEST-001`)

- **Scope**: PLACEMENT-phase drag-and-drop only. Does **not** cover GAME_OVER, lobby flow, draft grid, or shop / auction flows beyond what is incidentally exercised reaching PLACEMENT.
- **Capture mode**: live two-client friend-game session (host + joiner on local network); both clients with the documented `RUST_LOG` invocation; raw `.log` capture preserved per client; per-attempt `.png` screenshot at moment of release for each of drag attempts A / B / C / D.
- **Truth-table**: every cell across the S1-S5 × {A, B, C, D} grid must be filled with PASS / FAIL / NOT-OBSERVED and an evidence pointer (log file + line range OR screenshot path + frame stamp).
- **Disposition**: exactly one of `{bug-reproduced, bug-fixed, cannot-reproduce, third-party-limitation}`. If `bug-reproduced`, name the offending S1-S5 stage explicitly with failing trace line range.
- **Time-box**: 1.0 day. If exhausted, lock truth-table as best-effort with `NOT-OBSERVED` rows; disposition `cannot-reproduce`; author diagnostic-only follow-on story with tighter capture spec.
- **No-claim**: no broad Standard-tier accessibility, no keyboard / focus equivalent of drag (those remain stories 014 / 015 + QA-COND-0005), no playtest validation, no full QA, no S8-QA-001-W1 closure.
- **No production code change in this story**: any repair lands under a separate follow-on story.

### HUD Timer Eyeball (`S11-HUD-TIMER-EYEBALL-VISUAL-001` — Should Have, conditional)

- **Scope**: cosmetic-only verification that the timer countdown renders during the three timed phases. Does **not** assert behavioural / synchronisation correctness beyond visible decrement.
- **Capture mode**: manual two-client friend-game session reaching `DraftInitial` (45s), `DraftShop` (30s), `Placement` (10-12s). At minimum one screenshot per phase capturing the visible countdown at start; ideally screenshots at start + midpoint + end per phase.
- **Disposition**: visual verification PASS / FAIL only. If FAIL, the story stays open and a tighter capture spec story is authored.
- **No-claim**: cosmetic only; no behaviour change asserted; no S8-QA-001-W1 closure; no broad HUD-completeness claim.
- **Authority preservation**: timer authority remains server-side via `S2CPhaseChanged` (ADR-009). No client-side optimistic phase mutation is introduced as a side-effect of any eyeball-time fix.
